nodes.label: VetoTheme
nodes.rationale: Every property is optional; anything left null keeps the built-in value from VetoStyles.css, so an app rebrands by setting only the tokens it cares about rather than restyling the whole library. Overrides are emitted as CSS custom properties on :root so they cascade into every component, including ones rendered into portals outside the provider's own markup. Token values are regex-guarded against characters that could close a style declaration/rule/element since they are written directly into a <style> block.
